'''Alinta''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a member of the [[Friends of the Republic]], an organization dedicated to covertly help the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
For many years, Alinta and her allies communicated with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] anonymously via a secret comlink by sending coded messages. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Alinta contacted Organa with crucial information regarding the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The woman claimed that a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] called [[Zigoola]] posed a possible threat to the safety of the Republic. Organa, not knowing what to do with the information, called upon his fellow Senator and friend [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who was good friends with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Padmé convinced Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to listen to Organa's story. Reluctantly trusting Organa and his source, Kenobi and Organa set off to Zigoola. Alinta sent coordinates one at a time to Organa, as a precaution. When Organa and Kenobi arrived at the last pair of coordinates, they found themselves at a [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. At first, it seemed as if the station were abandoned, but they soon found that a battle was in progress between Alinta's allies and the [[Kalarba pirates/Legends|Kalarba pirates]].

The [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and their [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] had already eliminated most of Alinta's allies, leaving her the last remaining of her group. Kenobi and Organa entered the fight and managed to defeat the remaining pirates and their droids, although Alinta was mortally wounded during the fray. She was too badly hurt to be saved by Kenobi's limited healing abilities, but the woman managed to give some information to them before she died. Alinta had one request of them before they left: blow up the station so no one would be able to retrieve any information. Organa and Kenobi received a data crystal with Zigoola's coordinates and scuttled the station to preserve the group's secrets.
